decisions.reason: The updated PowerPoint design is described only as adding explanatory slides; the evidence does not change or resolve the dynamic bullet-entry, overflow, or highlighted-bullet behavior.
This requirement concerns list hierarchy in Microsoft Word templates, while the source decision concerns an updated customer-supplied PowerPoint design.
The updated PowerPoint design does not affect legacy-content copy-and-paste behavior in the Word templates.
The source decision changes the design source for the PowerPoint template and does not alter the Word style catalog or its required coverage.
This requirement governs graphic bullets in the Word template set; no Word bullet-design change is entailed by the updated PowerPoint design.
The PowerPoint design update does not change the architecture or editing mechanism of interactive fields in the Word documents.
The source decision does not concern pasted tables, columns, page margins, or other Word copy-and-paste containment behavior.
The updated PowerPoint design has no entailed effect on manual line breaks after legacy content is pasted into Word templates.
The source decision does not alter the prefix, coverage, condition, or language of Word style names.
The PowerPoint design-source update does not change the supported Word environment or the Word templates' cross-user reliability requirements.
No change to the Word master template's required theme colors or available color options is entailed by the updated PowerPoint design.
The source decision does not affect the Board Meeting Word template's row-insertion formatting or workflow.
